criteria.test: G1 compares against best-so-far S* with a noise tolerance delta that is calibrated (repeat-scoring an unchanged version), not a raw vN-1 comparison; recalibrated when the rung changes
the generator's per-iteration edit budget is explicit, starts >1 and anneals to 1 on a stated schedule, and each edit carries a one-line falsifiable hypothesis
the archive schema records per-edit component, hypothesis, dS, dC, accepted; the generator is told not to retest a falsified hypothesis without new evidence
a stall rule (no gain > delta over w iterations) redirects part of the edit budget to never-edited components, without forbidding any component
a checker (not the generator) screens each diff BEFORE scoring and rejects evaluator-specific / rubric-echoing / inert edits
a size/cost gain-must-pay rule with concrete defaults (dC <= b0 + b1*dS) plus a pruning list for components with <=0 measured gain
a held-out evaluator, never shown to the generator, scores only the final candidate once; failing it blocks DONE
SKILL.md, INITIATOR.md and README.md agree on gates, steps, parameters, schema
RRSI (Xia et al., arXiv:2609.24972) is cited; every idea/number attributed to it matches the paper; adaptations beyond the paper are labeled as adaptations
maker-checker separation, substrate firewall, human checkpoint at escalation, and G1-G5 are preserved or strictly strengthened
SKILL.md <= 1000 words, INITIATOR.md <= 1300 words, README.md <= 1150 words; no domain-specific content in SKILL/INITIATOR
every new rule has concrete defaults and a score scale, and is unambiguous for an agent host to execute; no internal contradictions

rungs_preagreed.E2: adversarial, reject polish, demand every rule be derivable/operable
rungs_preagreed.E3: add Pareto axis: compactness (word count) vs rigor
rungs_preagreed.E4: red-team re-verifies every cited claim against the primary papers

stop: all criteria pass under E4 per the panel majority AND the held-out evaluator passes AND no [OPEN] substrate, OR 20 iterations (HALT BUDGET)
